shots.title: Verify global hooks and cross-repo policy
shots.notes: Confirmed ~/.codex hooks parse, dispatcher syntax passes, guard metrics fire, and Fathoms has no project-local .codex hooks.

conditions.description: Codex hook behavior differed from older assumptions about project-local and plugin hook loading.
Global user-level hooks are the active runtime path; project-local .codex hooks should be removed where present to avoid duplicate firing.
Local repos can pin older @slope-dev/slope binaries, so global dispatchers must handle SLOPE's own dev repo carefully and releases must propagate runtime fixes.

bunker_locations: src/cli/guards/worktree-check.ts blocked EnterWorktree before the recovery path could run.
yardage_book_updates: src/core/adapters/codex.ts - Codex hooks now use top-level hooks shape, one command per guard, user-level install support, dist fallback for SLOPE's own repo, supported hook count reporting, and Codex-resolved tool matchers.
src/cli/guards/worktree-check.ts - worktree recovery inputs pass through before concurrency checks.
src/cli/commands/hook.ts - install summary reports adapter-supported definitions and marks unsupported events.
docs/guides/codex-setup.md and docs/tech/codex-slope-hooks-handoff.md - global/project shim guidance and plugin hook limitations.
course_management_notes: Global Codex hooks in ~/.codex are active and verified after restart.
Fathoms has no project-local .codex hooks, so it should not duplicate Codex guard firing; its .claude hooks are separate and only affect Claude Code.
Publish a patch release so other repos using project-local @slope-dev/slope binaries receive the runtime guard fixes.

training.description: Used reviewer feedback to catch adapter matcher drift after the initial hook recovery landed.
training.outcome: Added tests proving Codex file-edit guards match apply_patch and combined search/edit matchers stay valid.

nutrition.description: Removed transient smoke session state after hook testing.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: A small integration bug turned into a useful hardening pass for Codex hooks, especially around recovery paths and cross-repo installs.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: When adding a harness adapter, assert generated matchers from toolCategories, not only raw guard.matcher values.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The installed hook count was correct, but the persisted registry count was misleading because multi-event guards deduplicate by name.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: Cut a patch release and update dependent repos so the global hook setup is backed by current runtime behavior.
